description: A painted scene of soldiers moving through a muddy trench lined with sandbags and timber props. The foreground soldier wears a steel helmet and a long rain cape and carries a bolt-action rifle; a hanging oil lantern lights the trench wall. Three more helmeted soldiers follow in single file. Beyond the trench, misty jungle-covered hills and a distant clearing with low buildings, a lit flare, and a long strip of ground. The painting fills the frame edge to edge. No text, frame or gore is visible. Era cues are a WWII-style helmet and rifle.
reason: Shows soldiers in a trench, but the card is a container ship (the Ideal X, a converted tanker carrying truck trailers). The picture has no ship, port, or cargo.
